sources.label: Modo Patches
sources.author: latanvillegas
patch_list: AMOLED - App menu
Restores native AppMenu resources and three verified bytecode injections.
AMOLED - Context menu
Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White to the verified Cromite context-menu content surface while preserving the transparent outer dialog window.
AMOLED - New Tab Page (tile resources)
Recovers original NTP tile icon background resources; NewTabPageLayout and Most Visited DEX changes remain pending.
AMOLED - Omnibox and search UI
Uses the saved runtime theme for verified LocationBarTablet background setters.
AMOLED - Settings
Uses the saved runtime theme for SettingsActivity, preference backgrounds and containment-card colors.
AMOLED - Tabs and tab strip
Resolves saved System / Pure Black / Pure White at runtime for the tab grid dialog surface.
AMOLED - Toolbar
Uses the saved runtime AMOLED theme for the verified Cromite ToolbarTablet background setter.
AMOLED automatic web darkening
Adds automatic AMOLED web darkening while retaining Cromite's manual and per-site darkening.
Cromite AMOLED native theme runtime
Bundles the native pure-color runtime without installing a duplicate theme or brightness dialog.
Cromite AMOLED settings entry
Adds the AMOLED and brightness entry to Cromite theme settings.
Cromite automatic web darkening with native theme
Synchronizes the existing web-darkening checkbox on theme changes, preserving manual toggles and site exceptions.
Cromite DevTools: native COPY button (experimental)
Embed verified DevTools frontend and bootstrap for Cromite 153; runtime behavior unverified.
Cromite web AMOLED decision guard (verification only)
Validates Cromite's web darkening decision structure without changing its behavior.
Cromite web content-setting 71 read-only probe
Opt-in diagnostic hook; runtime preference defaults to disabled.
Cromite web darkening final boolean return probe
Optional read-only log of final native force-dark decision; max 64 samples per process.
Cromite web theme policy native decision trace
Safe opt-in tracing at the native WebContents darkening decision; does not yet alter rendering.
Hide Android status bar
Uses the native Force Tablet Mode switch to hide status icons in browser and Settings; requires AMOLED runtime patch.
Hide status bar in Settings
Synchronizes Settings status bar visibility with native Force Tablet Mode when window focus returns.
Pure AMOLED / Pure White system theme
Resolves pure black/white semantic surfaces at runtime using the AMOLED dialog selection and Android night mode.
Translate Cromite to Spanish
Adds Spanish translations for Cromite-specific settings.
